title: Baby Crawling on Sunny Lawn by Hedge, 1932 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful Great Depression-era amateur snapshot showing an infant baby crawling across a grassy backyard lawn on a bright summer day. A neatly manicured tall hedge stands behind the child, with tree branches visible against a washed-out sky. The verso is handwritten in ink with the date 'August 13, 1932.' alongside a red developer stamp 'B11'.
